captions.detailed: A matte-black carbon-fiber dropper seatpost for a bicycle. It consists of a thick outer tube with a textured carbon finish, a collar at the top, and a narrower inner post that telescopes vertically. At the very top, a low-profile inline saddle clamp is integrated with metallic mounting bolts.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a carbon-fiber dropper seatpost. It must feature a dark outer tube, a sliding inner post via a prismatic joint, and an inline saddle clamp with mounting hardware at the top.
captions.factory: Create an ArticulatedObject containing two main parts: an outer tube and an inner post. Construct the outer tube using a Cylinder with a decorative carbon-pattern mesh overlay, capped by a collar. Model the inner post with a narrower Cylinder, topped with a rectangular Box and horizontal Cylinders representing the saddle clamp assembly and mounting bolts. Connect these parts with a prismatic joint along the Z-axis to allow telescoping motion.
